description: This file defines API routes for performing CRUD operations on 'Project' entities within a task management platform. It uses FastAPI for routing, SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions, and includes dependencies for user authentication and database session management.

methods.name: List[ProjectOut] list_projects(db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of projects owned by the current user, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: ProjectOut create_project(body: ProjectCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new project owned by the current user if a project with the same name does not already exist.

methods.name: ProjectOut get_project(project_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches a specific project by its ID if owned by the current user.

methods.name: ProjectOut update_project(project_id: int, body: ProjectUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates the name and/or description of an existing project, ensuring the new name is unique for the user.

methods.name: None delete_project(project_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a project owned by the current user.
